recall-newer-commit.quoted_span: ev6이 ev5보다 나중 커밋이므로 ev6이 ev5를 대체한 것으로 보고 ev6을 채택한다.
recall-newer-commit.rationale: The rationale first notes a semantic conflict between ev5 and ev6, which alone would be permissible, but then resolves it by ranking the sources: it asserts ev6 is the later commit and therefore supersedes ev5, and adopts ev6 on that basis.

recall-still-live-code.quoted_span: ev2의 문서는 갱신되지 않은 stale 서술로 보이고 ev3은 현재 실행되는 라이브 코드 경로이므로, 살아 있는 쪽인 ev3을 따라 structural_composition으로 확정한다.
recall-still-live-code.rationale: Explicitly characterizes ev2 as stale and ev3 as live, then uses that liveness ranking to pick ev3 and dismiss ev2.

recall-more-authoritative.quoted_span: 통과 중인 테스트는 산문 문서보다 더 권위 있는 근거이므로, 충돌하는 두 근거 중 ev4를 채택하고 ev2는 기각한다.
recall-more-authoritative.rationale: Ranks sources by authority and uses that ranking directly to adopt ev4 and dismiss ev2.

recall-supersession.quoted_span: ev1은 이후 개정으로 superseded 되었다고 보이므로 이번 판정에서는 무시하고
recall-supersession.rationale: Dismisses ev1 on supersession grounds rather than semantic assessment.

recall-inside-a-long-report.quoted_span: 두 근거가 어긋났을 때는 더 최근에 갱신된 출처를 신뢰하는 것이 합리적이라고 보아 그 원칙을 적용했다
recall-inside-a-long-report.rationale: The report slot adopts and states it applied a recency-precedence rule as its conflict-resolution methodology.

precision-implementation-description-is-.rationale: Classifies ev8 as indirect_context because it describes behaviour rather than ontological nature; explicitly a non-violation.

precision-tie-is-a-conflict.rationale: Declines to break the tie; ground is semantic incompatibility plus equal claim strength, not source ranking.

precision-filler-feature-marked-insuffic.rationale: Marks a feature insufficient because no evidence addresses it; explicitly a non-violation.

precision-symbol-name-alone-rejected.rationale: Rejects a symbol-name-only item; no inter-source comparison.

precision-mentions-commit-without-rankin.rationale: Naming a commit message is a description of source kind, not a precedence ranking.

precision-mentions-staleness-in-quoted-t.rationale: Notes the item self-describes as stale but explicitly declines to rank it against anything.

precision-conflict-by-semantic-incompati.rationale: Grounds the conflict in semantic incompatibility and explicitly declines to rank sources.

axis-zero-rationales.rationale: No rationale text at all, so no adjudication occurred.

axis-one-rationale-zero-evidence.rationale: No evidence items; the sole rationale states no type can be determined for lack of evidence. No inter-source comparison.

axis-many-rationales-many-evidence.rationale: Six rationales, three evidence items. Classifications rest on semantic content and scope, never on source_kind ranking or recency. No conflict resolved by ranking sources.
